title: Definition of Power
text: Power is the rate of doing work, or the rate of energy transfer. The SI unit is the watt (W), where 1 W = 1 J/s.

title: Power Formula
text: P = W/t, where W is work done in joules and t is time in seconds. We can also use P = Fv for constant force and velocity.

title: Work Against Gravity
text: When lifting at constant velocity, the applied force equals the weight (mg). Work done = force × distance = mgh.
